system/default.description: Default system prompt injected before every AI call

stories/create.description: Generate a personalized story for a child

activities/create.description: Generate a hands-on activity from a theme
activities/create.output_format: structured: Title, Materials, Instructions, Challenge Question

activities/generate.description: Generate a hands-on activity from a story
activities/generate.output_format: structured: Title, Materials, Instructions, Challenge Question

reflections/image.description: Generate a positive reflection on a child's artwork/image

science_projects/generate.description: Generate a science project idea aligned with CBSE curriculum
science_projects/generate.output_format: JSON: project_title, subject, grade, topic, difficulty, estimated_build_time, estimated_cost, short_description, learning_objectives, curriculum_alignment

science_projects/materials.description: Generate detailed materials list for a science project
science_projects/materials.output_format: JSON: project_title, materials[], total_estimated_cost_rs, safety_items_required, alternative_materials

science_projects/build_steps.description: Generate step-by-step build instructions for a science project
science_projects/build_steps.output_format: JSON: project_title, total_steps, steps[], precautions, adult_supervision_required, tips_for_success

science_projects/explanation.description: Explain the science behind a project for CBSE students
science_projects/explanation.output_format: JSON: project_title, scientific_principle, simple_explanation, how_project_demonstrates, real_world_applications, simple_analogy, curriculum_relevance, advanced_topics

science_projects/difficulty.description: Analyze difficulty level of a science project
science_projects/difficulty.output_format: JSON: overall_difficulty, material_complexity, build_complexity, concept_complexity, estimated_time_minutes, adult_supervision_level, recommended_for_grade, simplification_tips

teacher_assistant/mcq.description: Generate multiple-choice questions for CBSE subject/chapter
teacher_assistant/mcq.output_format: JSON: subject, grade, chapter, topic, questions[], total_marks, time_recommended_minutes

teacher_assistant/short_answer.description: Generate short-answer questions for CBSE subject/chapter
teacher_assistant/short_answer.output_format: JSON: subject, grade, chapter, topic, questions[], total_marks, time_recommended_minutes

teacher_assistant/long_answer.description: Generate long-answer questions for CBSE subject/chapter
teacher_assistant/long_answer.output_format: JSON: subject, grade, chapter, topic, questions[], total_marks, time_recommended_minutes

teacher_assistant/worksheet.description: Generate a practice worksheet for CBSE subject/chapter
teacher_assistant/worksheet.output_format: JSON: subject, grade, chapter, topic, total_marks, sections[], total_time_minutes, instructions

teacher_assistant/custom_assessment.description: Generate a custom assessment based on teacher-specified question types, counts, and marks
teacher_assistant/custom_assessment.output_format: JSON: subject, grade, chapter, topic, total_marks, sections[], total_time_minutes, instructions

teacher_assistant/exam_paper.description: Generate a full exam paper for CBSE subject/chapters
teacher_assistant/exam_paper.output_format: JSON: subject, grade, exam_title, total_marks, duration_minutes, general_instructions, sections[], answer_key, blueprint
